snippet.title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance - 1st Trailer | TGS 2026 Extended Cut
snippet.description:
Check out an extended version of the 1st Trailer for Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance for Tokyo Game Show 2026, with a fiery addition to close things out.

The massive Elder Dragon's attack heralds change in the Forbidden Lands, for both land and sky. Bracing for danger, the Expedition steels themselves as familiar and undiscovered Elder Dragons emerge - and a disturbing new threat prowls the land. The Wilds evolve with the massive expansion, Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance, coming in 2027!

Official website
https://www.monsterhunter.com/wilds-ascendance

*Footage represents a game still in development. The main Monster Hunter Wilds game is required to play Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance.

About Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance

Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance takes the hunt to new heights in Master Rank. New monsters and challenges, evolved hunting actions and mechanics, a new locale, and the next chapter in the Expedition Team's story await in 2027 on PS5, XBOX Series X|S, PC, and Nintendo Switch 2.
